The '''Ylix militia''' was the military force which defended [[Ylix]] in its [[Goelitz-Ylix War|war]] against [[Goelitz]].

==History==
[[Ylix]] and [[Goelitz]] had an [[Goelitz-Ylix War|ancient rivalry]]. Terrorists from Goelitz frequently struck against Ylix, forcing the Ylix militia to defend its homeworld. Around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the militia waged a war against Goelitz which spread across dozens of worlds, subduing Goelitz after a devastating campaign. [[Gallandro/Legends|Gallandro]] served as a member of the militia, and made a name as one of the force's noted war heroes.<ref name="Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook" />
